item.title: Tracing Quality in Small-Batch Work
item.description: Follow a small stationery workshop as it checks bookmark widths, investigates a recurring fault and decides what to do with the affected pieces.

children.definition: An identifier assigned to a group of items produced together so that the group can be distinguished from others.
children.example: The packing assistant copied the lot code onto each sleeve so the workshop could link a complaint to the right group of bookmarks.

children.definition: The ability to establish an item's origin and reconstruct its production and handling history from linked records.
children.example: The coordinator restored traceability by using the packing sheet to link each sleeve’s lot code to the bookmarks’ production and inspection records.
children.translation_uz: mahsulotning kelib chiqishi, qanday ishlab chiqarilgani va keyingi bosqichlarda u bilan nima qilinganini qaydlar orqali aniqlash imkoniyati

children.definition: A document that captures the work performed, checks made and decisions taken for a particular group of items produced together.
children.example: The supervisor consulted the batch record to see which trays had already been checked for width.
children.translation_uz: partiyani ishlab chiqarish va tekshirish natijalari qayd etiladigan hujjat

children.definition: A fault in an individual item that causes it to fall short of a specified requirement.
children.example: The inspector noted a defect on one bookmark where a torn edge caught on the sleeve.

children.definition: A set of instructions specifying which items to examine, what to check and how to carry out the checks.
children.example: The inspection plan called for checking width and edge condition on pieces from every tray, including those packed last.

children.definition: A numerical limit used to decide whether the overall result of a quality check is sufficient for a group of items to pass.
children.example: The quality lead applied the acceptance threshold and held the lot because too many of the bookmarks inspected were outside the permitted width range.

children.definition: The extent to which readings agree when the same characteristic is checked more than once under comparable conditions.
children.example: To check measurement consistency, the inspector measured the same bookmark three times, lifting it and placing it back against the ruler each time.

children.definition: Additional work on an existing item to bring it into line with the original requirements.
children.example: The workshop lead approved rework for the bookmarks that were too wide because those pieces could still be brought within the permitted range.

children.definition: The physical separation of items with different quality statuses to prevent them from being mixed.
children.example: The packing assistant maintained segregation by moving the tray of questionable bookmarks away from the trays cleared for packing.
children.translation_ru: раздельное размещение изделий с разным статусом по результатам контроля
children.translation_uz: buyumlarni tekshiruvdagi maqomiga qarab alohida joylashtirish

children.definition: A gradual movement of production results away from their intended value over successive observations.
children.example: A steady increase in bookmark width from the first tray to the last suggested process drift, even though the early pieces were still within limits.
children.translation_ru: постепенное отклонение результатов процесса от целевого значения
children.translation_uz: jarayon natijalarining moʻljaldagi qiymatdan asta-sekin ogʻishi

children.definition: The permitted deviation from the specified value of a measurable characteristic.
children.example: The inspector used the width tolerance to decide whether an individual bookmark was close enough to the specified width.

children.definition: The underlying reason a problem occurred, whose removal would help prevent it from recurring.
children.example: The technician identified the root cause of the widening bookmarks after finding that a loose guide moved slightly between trays.

children.definition: Measures aimed at stopping an identified problem from happening again by addressing why it occurred.
children.example: The supervisor assigned responsibility for recurrence prevention to the workshop lead, who added a guide check to the start of each run.

children.definition: The formal decision about what to do with items held for a quality issue, such as authorizing further work or removal from stock.
children.example: The quality lead recorded the disposition for the held bookmarks, authorizing further work on the wide pieces and removing the torn ones from stock.
children.translation_ru: официальное решение о дальнейших действиях с изделиями, задержанными из-за проблем с качеством
children.translation_uz: sifat muammosi tufayli ajratib qoʻyilgan buyumlar boʻyicha qanday chora koʻrish toʻgʻrisidagi rasmiy qaror
